description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cognizant is hiring a Full Stack Software Developer to build and maintain scalable, reactive web applications using modern full-stack technologies. The role contributes to application development, testing, DevOps practices, and collaboration with Agile teams while supporting ongoing learning and innovation.
Full Stack Software Developer building Java/Spring Reactive web apps, reactive microservices, RESTful APIs, and React JS interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Reactive, and React JS
• Design and implement RESTful APIs and reactive microservices
• Build responsive, dynamic, and accessible user interfaces using React JS
• Write clean, modular, and well-documented code
• Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
• Participate in peer code reviews
• Debug and resolve issues across the stack
• Use Git for version control and collaborate via GitHub or GitLab
• Work with CI/CD pipelines
• Explore and utilize AI-powered tools like GitHub Copilot or Cursor
• Stay updated with emerging technologies
• Participate in tech talks, workshops, and hackathons
• Work in Agile teams and participate in ceremonies
• Collaborate with designers, QA engineers, and backend developers
• Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders
• Maintain technical documentation
• Provide regular updates on progress

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field
• Strong foundation in Java and OOP
• Exposure to Spring Boot and Reactive Programming
• Basic understanding of React JS, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Familiarity with REST APIs
• Good problem-solving and communication skills
• Experience with GitHub Copilot or Cursor
• Knowledge of Git, Docker, and CI/CD tools
• Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
• Applicants must be willing to relocate to this major geographic area
• Due to the nature of this position, Cognizant cannot provide sponsorship for U.S. work authorization (including participation in a CPT/OPT program) for this role
